page_title: LAZ 0-1 GEN | Lazio v Genoa 27/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's the end of the match.
90+9' The linesman makes the right call and Lazio will have a corner.
90+6' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Livio Marinelli blows for a foul.
90+4' A yellow-coloured card is received by Ciro Immobile (Lazio).
90+4' That will be all from Albert Gudmundsson who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Filip Jagiello (Genoa).
90+3' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) gets a yellow card.
90+2' The referee has issued a yellow card to Luca Pellegrini (Lazio).

90+1' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Lazio are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
85' Substitution. Aaron Martin (Genoa) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Stefano Sabelli walks off.
84' The free kick from long range, taken by Lazio, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
83' Matias Vecino (Lazio) jumps high after collecting a perfect cross and strikes with a bullet header! He sent the ball into the stands. What a miserable header!
82' Lazio couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Josep Martinez (Genoa) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
81' Matias Vecino (Lazio) receives a pass, beats an opponent and tries a long-range shot. It's a weak effort towards the bottom left corner and Josep Martinez easily makes the save.
79' Substitution. Danilo Cataldi walks off the pitch and Taty Castellanos (Lazio) comes on as a substitute.

78' Lazio slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
75' 10:4 – the total goal attempt statistics.
74' Lazio take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
72' The referee blows for a cooling break.
70' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Morten Thorsby (Genoa) comes onto the pitch so that Kevin Strootman can be given a rest.
70' Here is a change. Mateo Retegui is going off and Alberto Gilardino gives the last tactical orders to Caleb Ekuban (Genoa).
70' Here's the change. Ruslan Malinovsky leaves the pitch and Silvan Hefti (Genoa) comes on as a substitute.
69' Matias Vecino (Lazio) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.
67' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) will replace Felipe Anderson.
66' Maurizio Sarri has decided to make a change. Matias Vecino (Lazio) replaces Daichi Kamada.
66' Adam Marusic goes off the pitch and Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) comes on.
66' The corner is swung in but Lazio can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
65' Ciro Immobile (Lazio) smashes the ball against the crossbar! What a chance.
63' Corner kicks – 11:1.
63' The referee awards a corner and Luis Alberto (Lazio) goes over to take it.
61' The referee shows the yellow card to Ruslan Malinovsky (Genoa).
58' Lazio have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
56' Lazio work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
52' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Lazio comes to nothing.

51' Luis Alberto (Lazio) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the top right corner, but Josep Martinez makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round! The referee blows his whistle, Lazio are awarded a corner kick.
50' Luis Alberto (Lazio) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
48' Daichi Kamada (Lazio) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Livio Marinelli blows his whistle for an infringement.
48' A pass from Luis Alberto (Lazio) is intercepted by Josep Martinez and the move breaks down.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+7' The match has reached half-time.
45+5' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Lazio.
45+4' The resulting set piece from Lazio is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

45+4' Milan Badelj (Genoa) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Livio Marinelli with no other option than to blow for a foul.
45+2' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Lazio.
45+2' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Lazio.
45' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
43' The Lazio players can’t believe it after referee Livio Marinelli signals NO PENALTY after the VAR review. Play to continue.
42' There's a break in play and referee Livio Marinelli must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Lazio using VAR. This could be interesting!
39' Morten Frendrup (Genoa) is booked.
38' Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
34' The corner from Luis Alberto (Lazio) is intercepted by Josep Martinez.
33' Lazio failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
32' Referee Livio Marinelli signals NO PENALTY for Lazio after a VAR review!
31' Referee Livio Marinelli makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Lazio. Let’s see what happens!
30' Radu Dragusin (Genoa) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!

29' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Lazio are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
26' A cooling break is underway.
24' Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
22' The current number of shots on goal is 0:3.
18' Livio Marinelli sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
17' The Genoa players halt their celebrations as referee Livio Marinelli makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
16' 0 - 1 Mateo Retegui (Genoa) gets to a rebound inside the six-yard box and produces a header. He manages to put the ball into the middle of the goal, and thus alter the score to 0:1.
16' Ivan Provedel is equal to the effort from the edge of the box by Morten Frendrup (Genoa), pushing the ball around the post to safety.
15' Lazio are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
12' OFF THE POST! Johan Vasquez (Genoa) takes a shot from outside the box and hits the right post!
11' Lazio can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
10' Wonderful movement by Lazio. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
8' Livio Marinelli blows for a foul after Mattia Bani (Genoa) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
4' Genoa seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
3' A brilliant cross into the box finds Mateo Retegui (Genoa), who directs his header to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper shows his reflexes and makes an astonishing save.
1' Genoa take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Lazio will take the kick-off.
Livio Marinelli will officiate today.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
